timeline.summary: A Phyrexian shreds Trennet's shell, leaving him exposed; he casts magic at the Phyrexians and hides behind Sarja's shell.
timeline.quote: He wasted no time, and hurled magic at the Phyrexians.

citation.work: A Tale of Two Clone Shells
citation.text: "A Tale of Two Clone Shells". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Each time the Phyrexians destroy Sarja's shell another humanoid shell emerges; Trennet tears at it and finds only more shells.
timeline.quote: all he found underneath was more clone shells.

citation.work: A Tale of Two Clone Shells
citation.text: "A Tale of Two Clone Shells". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Trennet dominates the drake-lord's mind and turns it against the other Phyrexians, destroying them.
timeline.quote: It worked. He now commanded the huge Phyrexian beast.

citation.work: A Tale of Two Clone Shells
citation.text: "A Tale of Two Clone Shells". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: As Phyrexian contagion corrodes Karn's body, the praetors whisper psalms to corrupt his mind.
timeline.quote: As the Phyrexian contagion corroded Karn's body, the praetors whispered psalms to corrupt his mind.

citation.text: Praetor's Counsel (Mirrodin Besieged, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Many angels fight and die resisting Phyrexia on Mirrodin and several are captured and compleated.
timeline.quote: Several of these were captured and forcefully compleated .

citation.text: "Angel", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The companions fight Phyrexian butchers and escape through a meat shaft.
timeline.quote: Elspeth slew many, but they were outnumbered

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth rages and slays every Phyrexian in a surgery room, freeing Melira.
timeline.quote: slaying all the Phyrexians in the room in a matter of moments

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirrans are broken down and rebuilt as loyal servants of the force they had fought.
timeline.quote: Mirrans were broken down and rebuilt, made to be loyal servants of the force they had fought.

citation.text: Lost Leonin (New Phyrexia, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Phyrexia's victory, each sect begins perfecting its vision.
timeline.quote: With Phyrexia's victory at hand, each sect began perfecting its vision.

citation.text: Master Splicer (New Phyrexia, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Viridian Betrayers hunt their surviving kin to secure a place in Phyrexia's ranks.
timeline.quote: To secure a place in Phyrexia's ranks, they hunted their surviving kin.

citation.text: Viridian Betrayers (New Phyrexia, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians take over the plane and drive the Mirrans into hiding.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians succeeded in taking over the plane

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: New Phyrexia switches places with Zhalfir after a coalition defeats the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexia switched places in the fabric of existence with the formerly phased out Zhalfir

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The advance of Phyrexia nearly exterminates the Mirrans.
timeline.quote: leading to a near-complete genocide of the Mirrans, with fewer than twenty escaping to Zhalfir at the end of the Invasion.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Mirran Resistance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth dies and the Phyrexian hivemind ceases to function, at least temporarily.
timeline.quote: This first happened with Yawgmoth 's death and later with Elesh Norn 's.

citation.text: "Phyrexian", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian influence spreads until only pockets of Mirran Resistance remain, and the plane is renamed New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the phyrexians renamed it New Phyrexia

citation.text: "Phyrexian", section "New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The new Phyrexians split into five factions, each led by a praetor, and Elesh Norn's white-aligned faction subdues the rest and becomes Mother of Machines.
timeline.quote: managed to subdue the other factions and install her as Mother of Machines

citation.text: "Phyrexian", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians target the Aetherflux Reservoir in the New Phyrexian Invasion and most citizens are evacuated beforehand.
timeline.quote: Most of the city's citizens were evacuated days before the invasion.

citation.text: "Ghirapur", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slag-workers cleanse the area of the incompleat.
timeline.quote: The slag-workers wasted no time in creating their own flare pulses to cleanse the area of the *incompleat*.

citation.text: Whipflare (Commander 2016, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The oil created the mycosynth, which created New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

citation.text: Mycosynth Wellspring (Commander 2016, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Melira says Phyrexians cannot imbue a weapon with part of a soul.
timeline.quote: something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing.

citation.text: Loxodon Warhammer (Commander 2016, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During New Phyrexia's invasion of the multiverse the crypt is opened by the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: During New Phyrexia's invasion of the multiverse, it was opened by the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The survivors arrive at Naktamun and find the Scarab God and Locust God already fighting the Phyrexian invaders.
timeline.quote: they found the Scarab God and Locust God already there, engaged with the invaders

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret ignites the glistening oil in the Phyrexians' veins and Djeru's crop dismembers them.
timeline.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi explains he created a time rift to phase Zhalfir out of Dominaria to protect it from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: So I created a time rift and phased Zhalfir partially out of this plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Ashiok savors Elspeth's twisted dreams and learns of the Phyrexians, then is speared by Elspeth's Shadowspear and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: After being speared by Elspeth's Shadowspear , Ashiok planeswalked away

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Beyond Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria begins.
timeline.quote: The second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria begins.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi borrows the Moonsilver Key and warns Arlinn about Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: "They're called Phyrexians.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo and Kaito are unprepared for the praetor.
timeline.quote: For all their planning, Tamiyo and Kaito were unprepared to face the full power of a Phyrexian praetor.

citation.text: Spell Pierce (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Shimmer Myr evades Phyrexians by hiding between seconds.
timeline.quote: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

citation.text: Shimmer Myr (Neon Dynasty Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Anhelo shows Elspeth a fountain statue of an angel fighting a spined creature, which Elspeth recognizes as a Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: Anhelo might not know what it was, but she certainly did.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Vivien read the archives and learn the Phyrexians once attacked Capenna and the Demon Lords betrayed the angels to make Halo.
timeline.quote: The demons ultimately betrayed the angels

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: A single Phyrexian ship invades Capenna, eating hope and poisoning the plane, and nearly succeeds before the archangels' intervention.
timeline.quote: a single Phyrexian ship invaded Capenna

citation.text: "Capenna", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The archangels see they cannot win as the Phyrexians raise the mortal dead against their comrades.
timeline.quote: it was plain to the archangels that they could not win

citation.text: "Capenna", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and her mother are captured by Phyrexians and held in prison.
timeline.quote: When she was thirteen years old, she and her mother were captured by Phyrexians and held in prison a stone's throw from her childhood village.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian tears out her mother's throat before her eyes.
timeline.quote: her mother's throat was torn out in front of her by a Phyrexian

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Phyrexian attack, archangels and demonlords strike an unlikely deal that creates the metropolis of New Capenna.
timeline.quote: An unlikely deal between arch angels and demonlords created the metropolis of New Capenna.

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The last elevator arrives and New Capenna is sealed to all below after the final battle.
timeline.quote: The enemy rebuffed, the last elevator arrived, and New Capenna was sealed to all below.

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Demon Lords use the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappear.
timeline.quote: The Demon Lords used the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappeared themselves.

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians arrive on a ship and overwhelm Capenna's defenders, reanimating and phyrexianizing the dead over almost a year.
timeline.quote: their dead were reanimated and phyrexianized, joining the ranks of the Phyrexians

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna", section "The invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Angels and demons build a fortress on a plateau that becomes New Capenna; the final fight takes place at the base of the elevators and the city is sealed.
timeline.quote: After the final elevator departed towards the city, New Capenna was sealed

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna", section "Creation of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norn addresses the Phyrexian faithful in the Fair Basilica's courtyard while holding a captive Mirran, to be flayed and altered as an example of the Machine Orthodoxy.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.quote: "She was a vessel so corrupt, not even our glistening oil could save her.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.quote: it struck Liliana in the shoulder.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.quote: A Phyrexian , Ulf realized with horror.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi brings Karn a captured Phyrexian saboteur that was in the food stores; Karn burns it in a crucible.

citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn sees that the Weatherlight has been compleated and is dropping Phyrexian horrors onto the deck.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians had compleated the Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.
